DB_TYPE.description: Database engine: postgres for production, sqlite for local dev

PG_HOSTNAME.description: PostgreSQL server hostname (e.g., localhost or Railway DB host)

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Initial admin username for master realm (first startup only)

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial admin password for master realm (first startup only)

KC_PROXY.description: Proxy mode: edge (Railway terminates TLS), passthrough, or reencrypt

KC_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Whether Keycloak serves plain HTTP internally

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Public URL users access Keycloak at; must match Railway domain

PORT.description: Port the service listens on inside the container
